title: OpenInEditorRequest
description: Parameters of editor.open. Says which file and which editor, never which command: whether the editor is handed a two-sided diff or a single file at a line is decided by the host from which sides of the file actually exist, so the renderer cannot ask for a comparison against a side that is not there.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path to the worktree root.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the file, as git spells it.

previousPath.description: Where the file was before it moved, for a rename or a copy. Absent otherwise.

line.description: Line to put the cursor on, counting from 1. Zero when the node covers the whole file, which the host reads as the top.

editor.title: OpenInEditorRequestEditor
editor.description: Which editor to launch. vscode and visual_studio are the two the host discovers for itself; custom runs the command the user configured, and is rejected when they have configured none.
